label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee gathering for my forty years as mayor, in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, apparently coordinated with the builder's lighting inspection and escort. Freight is organizing lanterns and 200 fresh loaves and seeking coordination with the builder and innkeeper; their full involvement is not yet confirmed. The secretary has relayed arrangements and checked supplies, and the baker has supplied 32 loaves, with 168 still requiring ingredients. This began as an undisclosed surprise, but the secretary has now told me. I plan to keep the appointment and seek confirmation of bread freshness, delivery, and the remaining cost before authorizing town spending.
